notes.title: Patch Notes - Exilus Viper Ver 0.01.20250606a
notes.content:
Greetings Nav Shard,

In this patch we have:

Stage 1 - UI layering fixes.
Stage 5b - VO overlap fix.
Stage 8 - Delaying intro skip input no longer creates galactic warzone...for now.

Elemental Weapon and Elemental Combo Weapon pickup sounds now reflect the chosen elements.
Some Weapons have received minor tweaks (PFX locator corrections and more shot locators).
Other minor background tweaks - with plenty more on the horizon!

We are likely to drop another "small fixes" patch this week, before looking at bring the standard difficulty back to the originally intended challenge (currently far too easy), before looking towards initial implementation of Pro Mode - but we do not have a specific time frame for this yet.

Thanks for checking out Exilus Viper, and being patient and understanding during early access!

notes.title: Hotfix/Patch Notes - Exilus Viper Ver 0.01.20250601b
notes.content:
Greetings Nav Shard.

This small patch fixes issues with UI layering and VO logic structure during Stage 2 intro sequence.

We also made some small changes to the Stage 2 and 3b boss HP totals - but this is by no means a serious "balance" patch. (That'll be on the way soon enough!)

Good hunting Exilus

notes.title: Patch Notes for Exilus Viper Ver 0.01.20250601a
notes.content:
Greetings Nav Shard

This one fixes some of the issues from yesterdays patch, (Including the stage summary selection menu for Stage 2).

Also some UI layering improvements and minor weapon changes.

Much more on the way, this ones more of a stabiliser!

We will be testing throughout the day, so there may well be a 01b hotfix/patch later

Thank you for your patience and understanding during early access!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Exilus Viper Ver 0.01.20250531a
notes.content:
Hey there Nav Shards!

This update contains some fixes to weapon behaviours (specifically while in focus mode), some UI updates, and some SFX changes here and there!

Also, you "shouldn't" take damage if you reach the stage summary on 7b but didn't destroy the boss in time... we'll keep an eye on it though.

There's many other small changes scattered throughout, as will be the case over the coming weeks.

We hope you are enjoying Exilus Viper! 

Thank you for joining us on its journey. More soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Exilus Viper Ver 0.01.20250529a
notes.content:
Added a bunch of new visual and sound assets, and tweaked some of the weapon loadouts.

Fixed some of the more obvious issues (VO overlaps and Trigger Logic).

Not the most expansive patch notes, but we are running on fumes here! 

Thanks to those of you who have tried our game, we hoped you enjoyed what's there so far.

Back soon with more updates.

PW
